overclaims: A verified funding estimate alone cannot support the whole proposition.
The review describes reporting on company activities alongside hype and speculation, cautioning against treating all coverage as prospective.
checks.note: The excerpt is exact and the axis, horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. Two problems. First, the limitation calls the funding estimate 'verified', but the packet's stated gaps say the PitchBook records and classification rules were not independently verified. The figure is only traced to CNN reporting. Second, e2's explanation says CJR is 'cautioning against treating all coverage as prospective'. The excerpt and context only describe coverage of company activities. No such caution appears, and one quoted source even says coverage tends to follow what companies say AI will do.
